title: Eventual equality of a finite family of module maps
statement: Let $I$ be a nonempty directed preorder and $F:I\to\mathrm{CommRing}$ a diagram with colimit $A$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Fix $i\in I$, a finite set $T$, and finitely presented $F(i)$-modules $M_t,N_t$ [def-sc-finitely-presented-module] for $t\in T$. Let $f_t,g_t:M_t\to N_t$ be maps whose extensions to $A$ are equal for every $t$. Then there exists one $j\ge i$ such that the extensions of $f_t$ and $g_t$ to $F(j)$ are equal for every $t\in T$.

proof.text: Reduce the directed preorder to its antisymmetrization, with a representative diagram and its transported colimit. Comparisons between quotient classes hold exactly when they hold between any representatives; thus a later quotient index lifts above i.
For each t apply the equality clause of finite-presentation module descent to f_t and g_t. Their equality after extension to the colimit is the hypothesis.

Choose a common upper stage for the finitely many stages and i. Transport every equality there by extension of scalars, and use the canonical composition isomorphisms to identify the iterated extensions with direct extensions of the original maps. If T is empty choose i. Undo the indexing equivalence to obtain the asserted stage in I.

theorem exists_stage_finite_family_map_eq
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] [Nonempty I]
    (F : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) [HasColimit F]
    (i : I) {T : Type v} [Finite T]
    (M N : T → ModuleCat.{u} (F.obj i))
    (hM : ∀ t, Module.FinitePresentation (F.obj i) (M t))
    (hN : ∀ t, Module.FinitePresentation (F.obj i) (N t))
    (f g : ∀ t, M t ⟶ N t)
    (h : ∀ t, (extendScalars (colimit.ι F i).hom).map (f t) =
      (extendScalars (colimit.ι F i).hom).map (g t)) :
    ∃ (j : I) (hij : i ≤ j), ∀ t,
      (extendScalars (F.map (homOfLE hij)).hom).map (f t) =
        (extendScalars (F.map (homOfLE hij)).hom).map (g t)
